entities.summary: Elena Oana Antonescu is a Romanian politician, lawyer and Member of the European Parliament (MEP). A member of the Democratic Liberal Party (DLP) since 2001, part of the European People's Party, she became a Member of the European Parliament on 16 June 2009.
